defs.def: causing great interest or excitement 令人激动的；使人兴奋的adv.

ex.s: But how exactly they acquire such intention-reading abilities will be an exciting topic for future research.
ex.t: 但它们究竟如何获得这种读意图的能力，将是未来研究一个令人兴奋的课题。

ex.s: What she proposed didn’t seem as exciting as the original project I had applied to, but I was going to give it my all.
ex.t: 她提出的方案看起来不如我最初申请的那个项目令人兴奋，但我决定全力以赴。

ex.s: These specialists could work at the office until ten each night, then look back and realize they would have loved to have gone home and enjoyed the sweetness of their family and friends, or traveled to exciting places, meeting interesting people.
ex.t: 这些专家可能在办公室工作到每天晚上十点然后回头看才发现他们本可以早点回家享受家人朋友的甜蜜或者去激动人心的地方旅行结识有趣的人。

ex.s: The last few years have been exciting because I've been following my heart to do what I love.
ex.t: 最近几年很令人兴奋因为我一直在追随内心做我喜欢的事。

ex.s: Pali Overnight Adventures offers children and teens exciting experiences this summer.
ex.t: 从广播到街头艺术，这只是17个独特夏令营中的4个。

ex.s: Handing out sliced oranges to bloodthirsty kids can be as exciting as watching your own kid score a goal.
ex.t: 给那些“嗜血”的孩子们分发橙子片，可能和看自家孩子进球一样令人兴奋。

ex.s: Understanding history is vital to understanding ourselves as a people and as a nation． History is much more than the study of dusty old objects and events long past． It is an essential part of who we are today and who we will become． Thornton Middle School History Fair Competition makes understanding history exciting， engaging， and fun!
ex.t: 理解历史对理解我们作为一个民族、一个国家的自我至关重要。历史远不止是对尘封旧物与久远事件的研究。它是我们今天之所是、未来之将是的本质部分。桑顿中学历史博览会竞赛让理解历史变得激动人心、引人入胜且充满乐趣！

ex.s: Moving into a new home in a new neighborhood is an exciting experience.
ex.t: 搬进一个新社区的新家是一次令人兴奋的体验。

ex.s: But compared with previous studies, she finds the speed of breaking down in this one exciting.
ex.t: 但与之前的研究相比，她发现这项研究中分解的速度令人兴奋。

ex.s: While going on your first trip to the UK is exciting, new and different customs can also be confusing.
ex.t: 虽然第一次去英国旅行令人兴奋，但新奇不同的习俗也可能让人困惑。

ex.s: It was very exciting and totally unforgettable.
ex.t: 这非常令人兴奋，完全令人难忘。

ex.s: It was definitely an exciting experience for a foreign student like me.
ex.t: 对像我这样的外国学生来说，这绝对是一次激动人心的经历。

ex.s: Exhibits such as these are certainly new and exciting, but are they really art?
ex.t: 像这样的展览肯定是新的和令人兴奋的，但它们真的是艺术品吗？

ex.s: The result has been exciting new art forms, such as digital paintings and videos.
ex.t: 其结果是激动人心的全新艺术形式，如数字绘画和视频。
